title: Grilled Fresh Green Beans
description: This fresh green beans recipe are grilled with onions, bacon, and portobello mushrooms until tender and smoky for a side dish on summer grilling nights.
ingredients: 2 slices bacon, cut into quarters, or more to taste
1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed
1 pinch salt-free seasoning blend (such as Mrs. Dash), or to taste

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Combine green beans, onion, and bacon in a bowl; drizzle with olive oil, season with seasoning blend, and stir to coat. Transfer green bean mixture to a grilling basket or wok.

Place the basket or wok on the preheated grill; cook, stirring every 10 minutes, until green beans are tender, about 30 minutes. Add sliced mushroom to green bean mixture; cook until tender, about 10 minutes more.
